## Inputs and mathematical scope
Inherit R247/R300 necessary-wall capacity recursion and frozen complete 2225 linear suffix splits, R296 six-line bank, R298/R299 core masks, R300 individual rejections, R301 saturated-first mask (R301 commit 6e93cd2d935464a7b13df165fc984128de88cbe2). Exact Git blob pins:
```json
{"s247":"fdbef2ee6e6c32573f3a1ccd171cb5337de520fa","s296":"8e8d8cf7a3a642da52992eedba1f205991d8a874","s298":"13a256b7dc24d83f8e1f56b8f363016928da2d19","s299":"faf4de0953220d3a4122117a3a0c4feacc335674","s300":"95adc01b2f8cd86eec92cbc4e572a466a8c4c73f","s301":"75918d86ade1e8e74f1022ca0c9afc8255e2f0ef"}
```
The suffix predicate is the inherited optimistic necessary-condition test, not a sufficient decision-tree witness. A root with a failing branch is impossible regardless of existence of quadratic coefficients. For each germ block of 14 consecutive bits, precompute the union of its incident support labels; the union over all seven blocks equals T(S) by distributivity. This is exact for each conditioned germ intersection S∩L, not a quotient replacing germs by unconditioned labels. Original 98-bit masks are preserved. Memoize the same recursion by (depth, full germ mask), test larger branch first; the latter only reorders conjunction. The recursion returns true optimistically for label count <= depth, as in R300. The linear suffix masks can omit germs with zero jet, as in R247/R300. An initial diagnostic incorrectly demanded every suffix split cover all 98 germs and stopped before any classification; removed that assertion (retain disjointness and exact bank size), no pilot results counted. The strict root masks still partition all germs. The computation uses exact bit operations; cutoff never implies rejection. Counts of newly rejected words are disjoint from R298–R301; survivors only passed this relaxation. No new coefficient solving.
